channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Ecuadorian fishermen sue Trump administration over drone strike
item.description: Crew say their boat was attacked by drones launched from US-operated vessel as part of 'manifestly unlawful' campaign.

item.title: Top IRGC commander in Iraq for talks amid Kataib Hezbollah tensions
item.description: Head of Iran's IRGC Quds Force to attend meetings over alleged oil smuggling linked to pro-Iranian armed groups.

item.title: Iran war live: Kuwait says intercepting ‘hostile’ drone attacks
item.description: Kuwait intercepts 'hostile' drone attacks as Bahrain accuses Iran of 'criminal attacks'.

item.title: Kuwait reports drone attacks as Iran, US trade attacks on Qeshm and Bahrain
item.description: Kuwait's military says its air defence was repelling drones as Iran and the US hit out at each other across the Gulf.

item.title: Palestinian woman, 72, shot dead by Israeli settlers in West Bank, health ministry says
item.description: Palestinians say there was an attack by settlers in al-Duyuk al-Tahta, while the Israeli military says the settlers fired after being attacked.

item.title: US loses measles elimination status after 26 years amid record case numbers
item.description: States have reported over 5,400 cases and 10 measles-related deaths for the first time since the early 1990s.

item.title: Trump says US taking 'very seriously' any Iranian plot against Washington
item.description: Tehran rejects any suggestion it was plotting a so-called dirty bomb attack on the US capital as "baseless".

item.title: UK sanctions firms over Israeli West Bank settlements
item.description: It marks the first sanctions since the UK announced a tougher approach to Israeli actions in the territory.
